title: Trace Compiler
subtitle: Can a real gallery's layout code become exact circuits?

chapters.title: Source Becomes Wires
chapters.blurb: The compiler reads real gallery source as a syntax tree, folds the constants, and turns everything else into wires.

chapters.title: One Step Below Seven
chapters.blurb: A comparison becomes an exact zero or one through relu, power-of-two scaling and clamps, forced by a width of 1732.

chapters.title: Five Calculations
chapters.blurb: Five independent calculations attack the exactness claim, and the report says where single and double precision part ways.

chapters.title: How Much Is Covered
chapters.blurb: The checked slices cover 64 of 221 statement units; what remains is named, and the lab's standing is stated plainly.
